purpose: commercial title and first-play visual slice

style_contract.tone: approachable and game-like without becoming childish, comic slapstick, or generic corporate illustration
style_contract.consistency: portrait and map art must depict the same person with the same face, age, PPE, outfit language, and signature prop
style_contract.readability: character identity must survive small in-game scale through silhouette plus at least two of face, outfit, prop, and posture
style_contract.world_rule: construction details, access routes, temporary works, materials, equipment, and safety cues must feel plausible rather than decorative

shared_reject_conditions: pseudo text or meaningless lettering on helmets, PPE, signs, or equipment
extra fingers, duplicated limbs, broken PPE geometry, or fused tools
portrait and map variants that no longer read as the same person
slapstick treatment of hazards or incidents

assets.production_brief: Landscape 16:9 construction foundation-stage strategy map. Apartment structure, tower crane, material yard, temporary access road, gate, rebar/formwork zones and worker circulation should create a readable playable diorama with foreground/midground/background depth. Keep the central worksite clear enough for interactive markers and characters. No readable brand or company text.

Young female safety manager, late 20s to early 30s. Soft oval face, alert eyes, short-to-medium black hair visible below a white helmet with a simple blue stripe and no text. Clean navy-blue safety vest. Focused but approachable. Upper-body portrait; one hand holds the inspection tablet and the other directs attention.

Same player identity as the portrait in a full-body 3/4 strategy-map pose. Helmet, navy safety vest and black inspection tablet must remain legible at small scale. Stable planted stance, active field-lead posture, no chibi proportions.

Veteran formwork foreman in his early 50s. Weathered round face, thick moustache and strong brows. Orange helmet without lettering. Dark charcoal vest with orange reflective trim. Broad stocky build. Gruff and decisive but not villainous; protective of the crew. Upper-body portrait with a clear pointing gesture and work gloves.

Same Kang Taesik identity as the portrait in a full-body 3/4 strategy-map pose. Wide planted feet, heavy square torso and one arm pointing toward work. Orange helmet and work gloves remain readable at small scale.
